description: Boreal Forest Fire: UAV-collected Wildfire Detection and Smoke Segmentation Dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Julius Pesonen et al. Automated image-based wildfire detection suffers from a lack of open-access data, especially data with annotations. Our dataset targets the gap by providing human and computer vision foundation-model co-annotated images from an uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) perspective from Finnish boreal forest environments. Coverage: national (FI); published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Excel, Image. The data are held in FGI Dept. of Remote sensing and photogrammetry and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 125086946035 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
